name: glyph-flock-text
title: Glyph Flock Text
description: Letters behave as boids: each glyph steers away from the pointer within its influence radius and eases back to its baseline slot when the pointer leaves, giving the headline a startled-school-of-fish quality.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Airy
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Pointer Repel: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
